title: Architecting Next-Gen High-Throughput & Zero-Logs Cloud Tunneling
subtitle: Hide Group delivers high-performance multi-protocol tunneling engineered for DPI evasion, ultra-low latency gaming, and ironclad privacy for developers, enterprises, and global resellers.
visionDesc: To establish Southeast Asia's premier cloud tunneling infrastructure, ensuring digital privacy, uncompromising end-to-end encryption, and near-zero jitter for gaming and high-volume workloads.
mission1: Deploy Linux kernel eBPF and native WireGuard edge nodes for line-rate packet switching without I/O bottlenecks.
mission2: Pioneer anti-censorship protocols (VLess Reality, Trojan-Go, Shadowsocks 2022) impervious to aggressive Deep Packet Inspection (DPI).
mission3: Guarantee 100% privacy on RAM-only ephemeral diskless nodes with an audited Strict Zero-Logs Policy.
techArchitectureSubtitle: The underlying distributed systems technology powering reliable, high-speed tunneling across 42 regions.
tech1Desc: Direct peering with global Tier-1 backbones (Telia, Hurricane Electric, Equinix, Cloudflare) for lowest-hop routing.
tech2Desc: State-of-the-art TLS masquerading eliminating personal domain certificate leaks and preventing ISP firewall finger-printing.
tech3Desc: Operating systems boot in volatile tmpfs RAM. All session states, connection traces, and buffers vanish upon reboot.
tech4Desc: Pure in-kernel cryptographic packet processing delivering wire-speed throughput without userspace context-switch overhead.
officeSubtitle: The Hide Group central engineering hub in Semarang, Indonesia, directing 24/7 NOC operations and protocol R&D.
ctaSubtitle: Deploy your GoVPN high-speed account in seconds with zero speed throttling.
